description: This file contains unit tests for the TensorFlow Go client, specifically testing tensor creation, serialization, deserialization, and reshaping functionalities.

methods.name: TestNewTensor
methods.description: Tests tensor creation with various data types and shapes, verifying correct shape inference and value encoding.

methods.name: TestNewTensorValidateDimensions
methods.description: Validates that NewTensor properly handles mismatched or invalid tensor dimensions, ensuring error reporting.

methods.name: TestTensorSerialization
methods.description: Checks serialization and deserialization of tensors, verifying the integrity of encoded/decoded data.

methods.name: TestReadTensorDoesNotReadBeyondContent
methods.description: Ensures that reading a tensor from a buffer does not read beyond its actual content, preventing overreads.

methods.name: TestTensorSerializationErrors
methods.description: Verifies proper error handling during tensor serialization, particularly for string tensors and truncated data.

methods.name: TestReadTensorReadAll
methods.description: Tests reading multiple tensors sequentially from a combined buffer to ensure complete read coverage.

methods.name: TestReadTensorNegativeDimention
methods.description: Checks that ReadTensor fails when provided with shapes containing negative dimensions.

methods.name: BenchmarkTensor
methods.description: Performance benchmarks for tensor creation and value extraction across various data types and shapes.

methods.name: TestReshape
methods.description: Verifies that tensors can be reshaped correctly, and the shape metadata updates accordingly.
